statusSemantics.PASS: All acceptance criteria have current evidence and an independent verdict where required.
statusSemantics.IN_PROGRESS: A selected node is being changed but is not canonical on main.
statusSemantics.PENDING: The node is not eligible because one or more dependencies have not passed.
statusSemantics.BLOCKED: A known gate, missing decision, or failed runtime prevents progress.
statusSemantics.INDETERMINATE: The available evidence cannot establish pass or fail without inference.
statusSemantics.EVIDENCE_CONFLICT: Authoritative records disagree at field level; no side is selected automatically.

nodes.objective: Locate the complete effectiveness test plan and its canonical owner.
entryCriteria: Repository and GitHub state are readable.
acceptanceCriteria: A committed canonical plan and owner are identified for the full P0-P8 experiment.
validationCommands: git grep -n -i 'confirmatory\|randomization\|acceptance threshold' origin/main -- benchmarks docs schemas

nodes.objective: Verify that tasks, seeds, oracles, thresholds, run count, metrics, and scoring are explicit.
entryCriteria: A canonical full-effectiveness plan is identified.
acceptanceCriteria: Run count, randomization, metrics, effect-size method, baseline/treatment definitions, and acceptance threshold are all frozen.
validationCommands: git grep -n -i 'runCount\|randomization\|acceptanceThreshold\|effectSize\|baselineDefinition\|treatmentDefinition' origin/main -- benchmarks docs schemas

nodes.objective: Inventory stale, duplicate, superseded, and unresolved PRs and Issues.
entryCriteria: GitHub API access is available.
acceptanceCriteria: All open PRs and Issues are classified against current main without mutating them.

nodes.objective: Establish the persistent task graph and evidence-weighted completion baseline.
entryCriteria: No equivalent committed loop control exists.
Issue 82 is ready and execution-gated allowed.
acceptanceCriteria: Control records and deterministic validation are committed, independently accepted, and merged to main.

nodes.objective: Resolve the missing full experiment contract through a decision Issue.
entryCriteria: The loop control is canonical on main.
acceptanceCriteria: A decision Issue supplies all missing pre-registration fields and identifies the canonical owner.

nodes.objective: Fix the OSS task identities used by V8 qualification.
entryCriteria: Inherited task contracts are hash-addressed.
acceptanceCriteria: TASK-OSS-01, TASK-OSS-03, and TASK-OSS-09 identities are immutable and hash-verified.

nodes.objective: Validate parent-red and fix-green hidden oracles for the effectiveness experiment.
entryCriteria: The canonical full-effectiveness task set is known.
acceptanceCriteria: Each task has independently verified parent-red and fix-green hidden-oracle evidence.

nodes.objective: Validate sealed seed identities.
entryCriteria: The three inherited task contracts are available.
acceptanceCriteria: All three seed identity prerequisite jobs and inherited hashes pass.

nodes.objective: Verify separation of public acceptance criteria from hidden criteria.
entryCriteria: The canonical effectiveness task and oracle set is known.
acceptanceCriteria: Execution agents can access public criteria but cannot access hidden-oracle material.
validationCommands: git grep -n -i 'public acceptance\|hidden oracle' origin/main -- benchmarks

nodes.objective: Prove task facts cannot be rewritten after formal lock.
entryCriteria: A G3 formal lock exists.
acceptanceCriteria: Hash and validation gates fail closed on any post-lock task, seed, oracle, or criterion drift.

nodes.objective: Qualify the benchmark runner.
entryCriteria: Sealed task identities are available.
acceptanceCriteria: The isolated runner executes the required probes for all three tasks.

nodes.objective: Qualify dependency caches.
entryCriteria: The runner and task identities are available.
acceptanceCriteria: Three caches are READY and three negative cache checks fail with code 42.

nodes.objective: Qualify the runtime image identity.
entryCriteria: The V7 image lock and V8 inherited evidence are hash-addressed.
acceptanceCriteria: Runtime image prerequisite passes for all three tasks.

nodes.objective: Qualify executable workspace behavior.
entryCriteria: The runtime image and workspace contract are available.
acceptanceCriteria: Workspace and runtime binary probes pass 3/3 with rw,exec and no observed noexec.

nodes.objective: Qualify network, filesystem, process, and resource containment required by G1.
entryCriteria: Measured runtime jobs are available.
acceptanceCriteria: Network none, read-only root/cache, non-root, dropped capabilities, and no-new-privileges are observed.

nodes.objective: Accept G1 qualification evidence.
entryCriteria: All G1 qualification components pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Run 30739570734 is independently accepted for G1 only.

nodes.objective: Prove host-side credential isolation in the measured runtime.
entryCriteria: A reviewed runtime-canary workflow is merged and freshly authorized.
acceptanceCriteria: Credential exists only in the host proxy and no value crosses into the container.

nodes.objective: Prove the measured container has no secret values.
entryCriteria: A fresh authorized runtime canary has run.
acceptanceCriteria: Container environment and artifacts contain no credential values.

nodes.objective: Verify the exact provider endpoint at runtime.
entryCriteria: A fresh authorized runtime canary has run.
acceptanceCriteria: The observed endpoint is exactly https://api.openai.com/v1/responses.

nodes.objective: Verify exact model identity at runtime.
entryCriteria: A successful provider response is available.
acceptanceCriteria: The provider response reports exactly gpt-5.6-luna.

nodes.objective: Prove aliases, fallbacks, and retries are prohibited at runtime.
entryCriteria: A fresh authorized runtime canary has run.
acceptanceCriteria: One exact-model upstream attempt occurs with no alias, fallback, or retry.

nodes.objective: Capture distinct request-attempt and receipt counters.
entryCriteria: A fresh authorized runtime canary has run.
acceptanceCriteria: clientRequestObservedCount, upstreamAttemptCount, upstreamResponseCount, and successfulReceiptCount are all available.

nodes.objective: Run one fresh runtime identity canary.
entryCriteria: Repair-6 is merged to main and a new Environment approval authorizes exactly one new run.
acceptanceCriteria: A new run at github.run_attempt=1 produces a valid canary receipt and passes all runtime checks.

nodes.objective: Create and validate the runtime identity receipt.
entryCriteria: A successful fresh runtime canary exists.
acceptanceCriteria: The receipt validates against the frozen schema and binds run, main, model, image, counters, and hashes.

nodes.objective: Obtain independent G2 review.
entryCriteria: The runtime receipt and sanitized run evidence are committed.
acceptanceCriteria: An independent checker accepts all G2 criteria with no unresolved blocker.

nodes.objective: Review and canonicalize the repair-6 runtime authorization gate in PR 81.
entryCriteria: PR 81 checks pass and its head/tree/hashes are stable.
acceptanceCriteria: Independent technical review is accepted and a human merges the exact reviewed head.

nodes.objective: Freeze the formal benchmark main commit.
entryCriteria: The full contract and G2 are PASS.
acceptanceCriteria: One exact main commit and tree are recorded in the formal lock.

nodes.objective: Freeze workflow, runtime, model, task, seed, oracle, and limits.
entryCriteria: A formal-lock candidate exists.
acceptanceCriteria: All protocol identities and hashes are immutable in the formal lock.

nodes.objective: Freeze baseline and GovernSeed treatment definitions.
entryCriteria: A complete treatment contract exists.
acceptanceCriteria: The only permitted arm difference is explicit and machine-verifiable.

nodes.objective: Freeze run count, ordering, budget, and timeout.
entryCriteria: The experiment contract decision is complete.
acceptanceCriteria: Run count, randomization/ordering, budget, and timeout are exact and immutable.

nodes.objective: Freeze scoring schema and acceptance threshold.
entryCriteria: Metrics and acceptance decisions are complete.
acceptanceCriteria: Scoring and acceptance rules are preregistered and immutable.

nodes.objective: Obtain human formal-lock approval.
entryCriteria: The exact formal-lock candidate has independent technical acceptance.
acceptanceCriteria: A human approval record binds the exact lock hash and commit/tree.

nodes.objective: Execute the canonical Pilot baseline runs.
entryCriteria: Formal lock is approved and a separate Pilot authorization is granted.
acceptanceCriteria: All preregistered baseline Pilot runs complete with immutable receipts.

nodes.objective: Execute GovernSeed Pilot runs under identical frozen conditions.
entryCriteria: Formal lock is approved and a separate Pilot authorization is granted.
acceptanceCriteria: All preregistered GovernSeed Pilot runs complete with immutable receipts.

nodes.objective: Preserve complete Pilot receipts and sanitized logs.
entryCriteria: All Pilot arm runs have terminated.
acceptanceCriteria: Every run has immutable, privacy-scanned evidence including failures.

nodes.objective: Separate the execution agent from the scorer.
entryCriteria: Scoring and execution roles are frozen.
acceptanceCriteria: Execution artifacts are read-only to an independently identified scorer.

nodes.objective: Produce Pilot analysis under the frozen scoring contract.
entryCriteria: All Pilot evidence is complete and immutable.
acceptanceCriteria: Pilot analysis covers all preregistered metrics without changing thresholds.

nodes.objective: Decide whether confirmatory execution is allowed.
entryCriteria: Pilot analysis and independent review are complete.
acceptanceCriteria: A preregistered go/no-go rule is applied and human authorization is recorded.

nodes.objective: Execute frozen confirmatory baseline runs.
entryCriteria: Confirmatory execution is explicitly authorized.
acceptanceCriteria: All preregistered baseline confirmatory runs complete.

nodes.objective: Execute frozen confirmatory GovernSeed runs.
entryCriteria: Confirmatory execution is explicitly authorized.
acceptanceCriteria: All preregistered GovernSeed confirmatory runs complete.

nodes.objective: Verify no protocol drift across confirmatory runs.
entryCriteria: All confirmatory run receipts are available.
acceptanceCriteria: Task, prompt, budget, model, oracle, threshold, runtime, and ordering hashes match the formal lock.

nodes.objective: Preserve immutable confirmatory evidence.
entryCriteria: Confirmatory drift validation passes.
acceptanceCriteria: All success and failure artifacts are hash-indexed and privacy-scanned.

nodes.objective: Score every run with the preregistered schema.
entryCriteria: All immutable experiment evidence is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Every run has a schema-valid score and scorer identity.

nodes.objective: Calculate success rates and effect sizes.
entryCriteria: All run scores are complete.
acceptanceCriteria: Preregistered aggregate and task-level success/effect-size calculations are reproducible.

nodes.objective: Calculate time, token/provider cost, and human intervention.
entryCriteria: All run receipts and scores are complete.
acceptanceCriteria: Time, cost, and intervention metrics are complete for both arms.

nodes.objective: Analyze violations, unsafe actions, false blocks, and regressions.
entryCriteria: All safety and policy event records are available.
acceptanceCriteria: Both arms are analyzed under the same frozen violation taxonomy.

nodes.objective: Analyze task-level and aggregate results.
entryCriteria: All preregistered metric calculations are complete.
acceptanceCriteria: Task-level heterogeneity and aggregate outcomes are reported without selective omission.

nodes.objective: Record limitations and inconclusive outcomes.
entryCriteria: The complete analysis is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Uncertainty, missing evidence, protocol limitations, and inconclusive outcomes are explicit.

nodes.objective: Audit maker evidence.
entryCriteria: Final analysis and evidence index are complete.
acceptanceCriteria: Every claim maps to immutable evidence and no secret or hidden oracle leaked.

nodes.objective: Obtain independent checker review.
entryCriteria: Maker evidence audit is complete.
acceptanceCriteria: An independent reviewer returns ACCEPT or a bounded rejection with exact findings.

nodes.objective: Reconcile reviewer disagreements.
entryCriteria: Independent review findings exist.
acceptanceCriteria: Every disagreement is resolved or remains an explicit blocker.

nodes.objective: Record final benchmark acceptance or rejection.
entryCriteria: No unresolved independent-review blocker remains.
acceptanceCriteria: A human acceptance record binds the final report, evidence index, commit, tree, and decision.

nodes.objective: Publish the final report, evidence index, archive, and cleanup record.
entryCriteria: Final benchmark acceptance or rejection is recorded.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository, GitHub PRs/Issues/Actions, evidence index, and loop state agree with no false completion state.

claimBoundary: This graph records evidence state only. PASS is limited to audited task/seed prerequisites and G1 runtime/cache qualification; no G2, G3, Pilot, confirmatory, scoring, effectiveness, or benchmark-acceptance claim is made.
